verdict.rationale: The chip itself is hardware, but Qualcomm ships a developer ecosystem around it (AI Engine Direct SDK, AI Hub, GenieX), so an official CLI is a fair question and the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence documents an official command-line tool. AI Hub describes optimizing and shipping models "with a few lines of code" and GenieX is called a toolkit, but neither is described as a CLI, so the verdict is none.
